# Public handoff update — v0.1.3-r10.36

The current handoff now includes a fixed two-task external-user catalog:

- Release: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/releases/tag/v0.1.3-r10.36
- Scientific candidate: `v0.1.3-r10.32`
- Task catalog: `docs/external/EXTERNAL_USER_TASK_CATALOG_R10_35.md`
- Reproduction helper overlay: `v0.1.3-r10.35`
- Coordination issue: https://github.com/ahvsjags/BioInterfaceOS/issues/2

Task A is an independently reacquired PMC6592156 source audit plus
paper-attached OOD run. Task B is a four-source common-target registry audit.
They are materially different real-data tasks. The catalog is an adoption
interface, not an adoption receipt; two distinct non-author users or
institutions must still submit signed, hash-bound receipts.
